name: blast-radius
description: Pane that shows how far this session's changes reach: files touched, risky commands, a running risk score.

openPaneAtStart.title: Open the pane at start
openPaneAtStart.description: Open the Blast radius pane when a session begins; off opens it only with /blast-radius.

toastFrom.title: Notify from risk weight
toastFrom.description: Show a notice for a risky command at or above this weight (1 to 9). Lower notifies more often.

extraRiskyPatterns.title: Extra risky commands
extraRiskyPatterns.description: Regular expressions for commands to count as risky (weight 5), comma separated. Example: terraform apply,kubectl delete
